dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a steep, slightly convex incline of approximately 65-70 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its maximum vertical height from the dorsal ridge is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch is visible on the trailing edge of the tail fluke (posterior region). Numerous small, white circular spots/speckles are distributed across the dark dorsal skin surface.
